summary: Decompose god function main in nlp2koru cli

delivery.outcome: Decompose main in packages/nlp2koru/src/nlp2koru/cli.py (PLF-038): move argparse construction into declarative ArgumentSpec tables plus _add_arguments and _build_parser, and route each dispatched subcommand through _cmd_to_dsl/_cmd_apply/_cmd_workflow/_cmd_rewrite handlers, dropping main from CC=12 / fan-out=16 / mutations=31 to CC=4 / fan-out=6 / mutations=1 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) with every new helper under the same thresholds, while keeping the public main(argv)->int contract, the nlp2koru console-script binding and byte-identical stdout/stderr/exit-code behavior for all four subcommands.
nonGoals: Changing subcommand names, flags, defaults, help texts or output formatting
Refactoring other functions in packages/nlp2koru (to_dsl, apply, llm_backend untouched)
Extracting cli.py into a new module or package

architecture.decision: Declare each subcommand's arguments as module-level ArgumentSpec tables (dsl2koru cli idiom) registered through a single _add_arguments loop, because code2llm counts every add_* method call as a mutation: the to-dsl and apply subcommands each take 5 arguments, so ticket-219-style per-subcommand registrars would hold 7 mutations (1 assign + add_parser + 5 add_argument) and stay above the mutation threshold. The spec loop keeps _build_parser at 5 mutations and _add_arguments at 1. Dispatch handlers stay in cli.py and call the module-level to_dsl/apply_nl/workflow_from_nl/rewrite_chat_prompt imports directly so existing nlp2koru.cli patch targets keep working (late binding through the module facade).
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline main function.

commands: python3 -c "from code2llm.api import analyze; r = analyze('packages/nlp2koru/src'); print([(s.name, s.line) for s in r.smells if s.file.endswith('cli.py')]); print({k: v for k, v in r.metrics.items() if 'nlp2koru.cli' in k})"
validation.evidence: The code2llm smell list contains no function defined in cli.py and every cli function reports CC <= 12, fan-out <= 10, mutations <= 6.

All existing nlp2koru tests pass unchanged (the dispatch-dependent test_apply_validate_lane failure is pre-existing on main and environmental) plus new main() dispatch regression tests covering to-dsl (text and --json), to-dsl error exit, apply --json, workflow and rewrite-chat.
Governance gate passes with 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
